newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: FINMIN 26-WEEK T-BILL YIELD AT 14.25 PCT.
newsitem.headline: FINMIN 26-WEEK T-BILL YIELD AT 14.25 PCT.

text.p: Net yield at the Slovak Finance Ministry auction of an unspecified tranche of 26-week treasury bills hit 14.25 percent, the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said in a statement on Wednesday.
The NBS added that all of the 73 million crowns worth of bids in the auction were accepted.
The statement did not give further details and ministry officials were not immediately available for comment on the result of the auction.
Wednesday's auction was the second of 26-week T-bills this year. The ministry rejected all bids -- which totalled 1.356 billion crowns -- in the previous auction on April 16.
The ministry does not set a limit price on bids in auctions of state securities, nor does it reveal amounts on the offer.
